title: Meet Zee
brief: Introduce Zee, Curate's stylist, to people who have never seen the app. Zee alone on the Mist ground, flipping moods on every beat of a playful track, then one line: Your stylist. No app footage, no product, no people. Built from motion test c2 (marketing/videos, 2026-10-15) as the first library-assembled ad and the template for the rest.
hook: A black plush kitten waves hello on the first beat.
disclosures: Zee is an animated character, not AI-generated footage; no AI label needed for this ad.
Music: Mixkit Stock Music Free License; not for TV/radio broadcast.
notes: Assets are not in the catalog until the migration (ARCHITECTURE.md › Migration) runs; until then this ad compiles and lists its compositions but cannot render.
